steps.en: Pressing Save opens a confirmation dialog
Cancelling the dialog sends and changes nothing
steps.id: Membatalkan dialog tidak mengirim atau mengubah apa pun

steps.en: Officer stays on the same filled-in screen
steps.id: Petugas tetap di layar yang sama dengan isian utuh

steps.en: Officer can change the message content and the decision
steps.id: Petugas bisa mengubah isi pesan dan keputusan
steps.why_en: Messages in the send list cannot be edited, only removed and rewritten, and changing the decision leaves old messages in the list.
steps.why_id: Pesan di daftar kirim tidak bisa diedit, hanya dihapus dan ditulis ulang, dan mengganti keputusan membiarkan pesan lama tetap di daftar.

steps.en: Officer can approve or reject again after the changes
steps.id: Petugas bisa approve atau reject lagi setelah perubahan
